themes_detail.label: Industrial Waste Dumping Spike
themes_detail.summary: Industrial waste complaints exploded to 3 last week versus a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 2300% spike—suggesting a sudden, acute dumping or contamination event hitting the Upper West Side this week that demands immediate environmental investigation.
evidence: 3 industrial waste complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Statistically classified as high-severity anomaly, indicating non-random event concentration
No prior trend in this complaint category suggests new source or operator activity
reporting_angles: Ground-truth the three complaints: locate addresses, identify dumpers, determine if linked to construction sites or illegal waste haulers
Interview DEP and DSNY about enforcement actions and whether a specific site or contractor is under investigation

themes_detail.label: Dead Trees & Green Space Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints jumped to 9 last week from a baseline of 0.5 per week—a 1700% spike—signaling possible disease outbreak, storm damage, or infrastructure failure affecting the neighborhood's canopy this week.
evidence: 9 dead/dying tree complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1700% spike, z-score: 8.5)
Aligns with recurring CB budget request for park reconstruction/upgrades, suggesting chronic maintenance gaps now manifesting acutely
Community Board's repeated asks to DPR signal this is a known weak point
reporting_angles: Identify the specific trees/parks involved: are these in Central Park, Riverside Park, or street trees? Is there a disease or pest pattern?
Interview Parks Department about tree health, maintenance budget, and whether this reflects staffing or seasonal issues

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Detection Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints surged to 8 last week from a 1.0 weekly baseline—a 700% spike—potentially indicating discovery of hazardous materials in older buildings or renovation work without proper disclosure, raising urgent health concerns this week.
evidence: 8 asbestos complaints last week vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike, z-score: 5.72)
1174 building alteration permits filed in last 90 days; 1088 are alterations—potential trigger for asbestos disturbance in older UWS stock
Upper West Side housing stock heavily pre-1980s, high asbestos exposure risk
reporting_angles: Map the 8 asbestos complaints: are they concentrated in one building, block, or renovation project? Cross-reference with DOB permit data.
Interview DOB and DOHMH about asbestos enforcement; query whether complaints relate to a single contractor or multiple sites

themes_detail.label: Curb & Street Infrastructure Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints jumped to 14 last week from a 3.0 weekly baseline—a 367% spike—paired with a 158% spike in street light complaints 2 weeks ago (28 vs. 10.9 avg), indicating rapid deterioration of public right-of-way infrastructure this past fortnight.
evidence: Curb condition complaints: 14 last week vs. 3.0 weekly average (367% spike, z-score: 8.98)
Street light complaints: 28 two weeks ago vs. 10.9 weekly average (158% spike, z-score: 5.45)
Two complementary infrastructure failures suggest systemic maintenance shortfall or recent weather damage
reporting_angles: Visual survey: photograph the worst curb and street light failures; identify streets with highest complaint density
Interview DOT and DCAS about inspection frequency, budget constraints, and response timeline for these complaints

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Bikes & Clutter Accumulation
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned bike complaints spiked to 5 last week from 0.6 weekly average—a 700% jump—suggesting rapid street clutter, possible bike-share disarray, or post-winter dump of broken cycles this week.
evidence: 5 abandoned bike complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike, z-score: 5.11)
Isolated signal with limited context; no corroborating community board or constituent complaints
reporting_angles: Contact Citi Bike and NYPD: are they aware of a rebalancing crisis, theft surge, or maintenance backlog?
Brief street survey to identify whether these are broken Citi Bikes, personal bikes, or both
